agent_parsed_json.verdict_reason: The code, Python 2.7 + TensorFlow 0.12.1 environment (built in Docker per README's stated requirements), and toy example all work correctly end-to-end (training, perplexity computation, topic printing, and sentence generation all succeeded), so the pipeline itself is not the blocker; however, the official dataset download link (IBM Box) referenced in the README for the paper's actual benchmark datasets (APNews/IMDB/BNC) returns HTTP 404, so the real experiments from the paper's results table cannot be reproduced with the available data.
